title: Concourse and a brief directory
prompt:

Harper <<<323570155312565>>> is the established adult woman; the starter image controls her warm-gray survival coverall, overriding any clothing in the identity reference. Medium concourse view. Harper looks from the small directory toward the real departure berths, with a natural tiny head turn and a relaxed breath; a few distant travelers walk slowly. Keep directory graphics abstract and stable. Very restrained camera drift. Do not introduce the spherical personal ship. No tapping fingers or large gestures. Preserve the starting-frame composition and painterly graphic-novel finish. Maintain active subtle motion throughout the usable central portion, with one-second editing handles. No generated transitions, cuts, dissolves, wipes, captions, readable text, watermark, audio or lip-sync. The right-to-left ship wipes will be added later in editing; do not generate them.

CONCOURSE SEQUENCE LOCK: Cinematic painted graphic-novel space adventure with fine controlled ink contours, rich illustrated material detail, indigo space, cyan practical lights and warm amber edges. Interior promenade has dark ribbed arches, warm ivory wall panels and a few distant travelers; its quieter outer service walkway retains the same architecture. The small arrival capsule is the established enclosed ivory-and-graphite ovoid one-seat escape pod, without a large external ring. The discovered personal spacecraft is the established transparent spherical technological field with faint cyan geodesic lines, graphite equatorial band, upper/lower circular platforms, amber rim lights, sparse cyan rectangular lamps and one vertical open aft engine ring with cyan inner arc; never confuse these two craft. Keep only subjects needed for the shot. Each image is one uninterrupted full-frame 16:9 cinematic composition with a quiet bottom strip for later lyrics; no captions, readable words, watermarks, panels or collage.
